supersedes_for_run2: the frozen_files_sha256 of fna4_solver.py, fna4_learners.py, run_fna4.py, test_fna4.py in FNA4_FREEZE.json
statement: Recorded AFTER run 1 was preserved as a defect run and BEFORE run 2. Salts, streams, arms, cost model and predictions P1-P7 are UNCHANGED from FNA4_FREEZE.json. What changed is two harness defects run 1 exposed; both fixes and their one-stage attributions are below. Run 1 receipts are preserved verbatim at defect_runs/FNA4_DEFECT_RUN1_RECEIPTS.json.gz (sha256 b0acd3c551716efb2b2d68007bdd597863ee1babd99fad431a4d9d88ff2d625d) and are never edited.

defect_1.name: state-oblivious macro application
defect_1.evidence_in_run1: EGGRAPH test arm: each of 3 macros attempted at 3721 state pops with a tape rebuilt from task.initial every time (4f6f88e1: 3721 states / 7442 assignments / 3721 misfires) -- identical work re-charged per state, and macros whose entry types are derived (e.g. zip over tokens) could never fire at all, contradicting the solver's own contract that a learned macro is 'one more catalogue entry'.
defect_1.attribution: application stage: the macro lane ignored the search state it was being expanded in.
defect_1.lever: entry-combo enumeration over the state's atoms of the macro's entry input types, exactly like a primitive expansion; the body then runs chain semantics (most-recent-of-type consumption) on the remaining tape; every body simulation, checker call and hole-assignment enumeration charged as before.

defect_2.name: first-chain-only experience recording starved every learner identically
defect_2.evidence_in_run1: acquisition receipts recorded only the incumbent's FIRST solution: on this world the shallowest goal-reaching compositions are coincidences (merge:2+zip:count on F1 draws, 2-step parse->agg on F2 draws), so the corpus every learner saw was coincidence-shaped. No F2-family-shaped macro was ever admitted (STITCH's entire library: a 2-node parse+filter fragment); sweep points above r=0 were non-constructible because the learned library covered almost nothing. P2 (break-even), P3 (EG vs AU on F2) and P6 (critical repeat rate) were unmeasurable BY CONSTRUCTION -- a harness defect, not a verdict.
defect_2.attribution: experience-recording stage: E_t was defined as the single first-found chain instead of everything the incumbent actually ran.
defect_2.lever: collect_all acquisition: the paid search runs to its bound with no early exit and records EVERY checker-passing chain (one charged bookkeeping step per recorded chain; the search itself was already paid). Test-time solves keep the early exit: fresh-task cost stays time-to-first-solution. Parent parity preserved: the identical full corpus goes to every learner, and acquisition still pays full search cost in every arm.

other_changes_in_776c8ff: ablation phase: same-mix no-library references for BOTH halves (run1 compared a F1-only half against a F2+F3 half)
CHUNK admitted under the shared MAX_LIBRARY budget like every other parent
run_fna4.py docstring phase list corrected (the nogood revival pair lives inside the main comparison)
three new invariant tests: collect_all corpus, derived-atom macro firing, oracle entry-combo ordering (16 total)
accounting_pinned_before_run2: collect_all acquisition charges the full cap-bound search (~13.5M units for the 8-task stream), which would swamp any payback comparison. The protocol's 'acquisition + stream cost' wording was ambiguous about whether the acquisition tasks' solve cost belongs to learning. BOTH accountings are reported everywhere, chosen before any scored number existed: full = deliberate exhaustive formation pays its whole search; marginal = the acquisition solves are the job's cost (paid identically by a non-learning system), consolidation adds only the learner/bookkeeping units (work_acq.learner_steps, which includes nogood probes and experience bookkeeping). No behaviour changed; both sides of every payback number are in the receipts.
unchanged_from_freeze: cost model (one commensurable unit per simulation/checker/posting/learner step)
